verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a Faults REST API that "returns a list of faults or a single fault for the given project," which covers listing and reading issues. The other API docs in the pack are ingestion endpoints (reporting notices, source maps, deploys), not data-access endpoints. Search syntax and resolve actions are shown only in the UI and Slack, not via REST. Missing for 10: API query/filter parameters for faults, update/resolve endpoints, fetching raw notices/events via REST, scoped or permission-limited API tokens, and an OpenAPI spec (probe found none).
